WATER RESOURCES MANAGEMENT (NYASA BASIN KAPAPA WATER SOURCE
PROTECTED ZONE) (ESTABLISHMENT) NOTICE, 2024
Name
1. This Notice may be cited as Water Resources
Management (Nyasa Basin Kapapa Water Source Protected
Zone) (Establishment) Notice, 2024.
Establishme
2.-(1) The area specified in the Schedule to this
nt of
Notice is hereby established to be Nyasa Basin Kapapa
protected
Water Source Protected Zone.
zone
(2) For protection of Nyasa Basin water sources
from pollution, erosion or any other adverse effects, it shall
be prohibited for any person to conduct any human activities
on land draining to, or above the protected zone.
GN. No. 766 (Contd)
_____________
FIRST SCHEDULE
______________
(Made under paragraph 3(1))
KAPAPA WATER SOURCE PROTECTED ZONE
Kapapa Water source is located at Mpanda village in Busokelo District Council and within Mbeya
Region. The protected zone has a total of 251,251,647 Square meters (m2), where the water source
is located in the Xmin 33.80833, Ymin -9.29954, Xmax 33.81087 with an elevation range from the
average of 1217 meters to 1233 above the sea level (As recorded in the –Global Positioning
System).
